levels.surface: الحسن بن یوسف بن عمیر النخعی

notes: «أَبِی ره» — the blessing «ره» is stripped; «أبي» is the compiler's father, named only by relation.

«حَدَّثَنِی مَنْ سَمِعَ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ» — «من سمع» is an unnamed transmitter, and the Imam is named in the words «سمع أبا عبد الله يقول», the owner's imam_in_text case; the «ع» blessing is not in the surface.
Diacritics are left out of every surface; the letters are the text's.
